purpose: Keep resumed work accurate while minimizing context bloat and duplicate state.

resume_load_order.purpose: resolve identity, owner, status, visibility, stage, next_action and checkpoint pointer
recover current execution truth and compatibility context

resume_load_order.load: exact referenced artifacts needed for next_action
resume_load_order.purpose: verify state against source artifacts without preloading unrelated history
resolve a concrete ambiguity or missing evidence only
last-resort recovery evidence when stronger durable state is insufficient

must_not_duplicate: unchanged domain rules already owned by the domain agent
handoff_contract.rule: Prefer stable references plus the minimum interpretation needed to resume safely.

task_topology.CONTINUE_SAME_GOAL: same task_id; keep current owner and checkpoint chain
task_topology.FRESH_HANDOFF_SAME_GOAL: same task_id; new chat takes over after checkpoint + compatibility + lease verification
task_topology.SIDE_QUERY: answer separately; do not mutate current_stage/next_action unless the answer changes the durable task
task_topology.FORK_CHILD_TASK: create a new task_id with parent_task_id when exploring a materially different major goal that should preserve the original task independently
task_topology.NEW_TASK: new task_id; inherit durable learning only, not unfinished execution state

signals_for_fresh_handoff: current chat contains multiple obsolete plans or contradictory branches
next_action cannot be stated compactly without replaying long history
task stage has materially changed and old context is mostly historical
model/tool/runtime authority changed and legacy execution semantics risk contaminating decisions
user explicitly requests a clean new chat
signals_not_sufficient_alone: an external heuristic such as a fixed 150K smart-zone threshold

verification.authority_or_persistence_change: full relevant continuity harness and end-to-end acceptance where available
verification.rule: Do not run broad unrelated tests merely because tests exist.
